author: Ari Koslow
title: David Bednar activated from paternity list
desc: The Yankees activated David Bednar from the paternity list.
impact: Bednar was away from the team for a few days. He'll return to his closer role in the Yankees bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ricky Tiedemann getting some injections in his neck
desc: Blue Jays pitching prospect Ricky Tiedemann is getting some injections in his neck.
impact: Tiedemann suffered a setback on his rehab assignment after feeling discomfort in his neck/shoulder area.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) could return next week
desc: Patrick Sandoval is in play to return from the injured list last week.
impact: Sandoval is an option with Connelly Early going down in his latest start. He made his latest rehab start last weekend on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cooper Hjerpe (elbow) activated from 60-day IL
desc: Cooper Hjerpe has been activated from the injured list.
impact: Hjerpe had been on the 60-day IL.

author: Ari Koslow
title: AJ Blubaugh drawing trade interest
desc: The Astros are reportedly drawing trade interest in AJ Blubaugh.
impact: Blubaugh has a 2.06 ERA in 48 innings since April 8. He is one of several bullpen arms for Houston drawing trade interest.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jung Hoo Lee swipes base in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Jung Hoo Lee went 2-for-4 in Wednesday's 6-4 win over the Diamondbacks with two runs scored, one RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: Lee continues a solid stretch of late, getting on base in 10 of his last 15 contests. The outfielder continues to reward manager Tony Vitello as one of the more impactful options in the Giants lineup, slashing .319 with five home runs, 43 runs scored, 32 RBI, and six stolen bases across 78 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zac Gallen struggles late Wednesday
desc: Zac Gallen allowed six runs on seven hits over 5 2/3 innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a loss on Wednesday against the Giants.
impact: Gallen had started his outing throwing four scoreless frames before things took a turn quickly. He is off the fantasy radar at this point.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Heliot Ramos goes yard as Giants outslug Diamondbacks
desc: Heliot Ramos went 2-for-4 in Wednesday's 6-4 win over the Diamondbacks with a home run, a triple, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Ramos has heated up at the plate since returning from injury, recording hits in three of his last four contests. The outfielder continues to offer manager Tony Vitello one of the more reliable options in the Giants lineup, batting .268 with six home runs, 23 RBI, and 23 runs scored through 48 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Gonzales collects three hits Wednesday
desc: Nick Gonzales went 3-for-4 in the Pirates 10-6 loss on Wednesday against the Phillies.
impact: Gonzales collected three singles on the night, raising his average to an even .300 on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Skenes struggles in loss Wednesday
desc: Paul Skenes allowed eight runs (seven earned) on six hits over four innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Wednesday against the Phillies.
impact: Skenes allowed five runs in the second inning after Nick Gonzales hit Alec Bohm running home with the bases loaded and one out. Trea Turner hit a three-run home run the next at-bat. Skenes will carry a 3.63 ERA into his next start against the Braves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Buehler roughed up Wednesday
desc: Walker Buehler allowed nine runs on seven hits over four innings with six strikeouts and four walks in a loss on Wednesday against the Cubs.
impact: This one got very ugly for the Padres, ultimately falling 23-3 with catcher Rodolfo Duran on the mound the last two innings. Buehler will look to bounce back against the Diamondbacks.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Victor Bericoto homers in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Victor Bericoto went 2-for-4 in a 6-4 win over the Diamondbacks with a two-run home run.
impact: Bericoto continues a torrid stretch at the plate, recording hits in each of his last six contests. The outfielder has rewarded manager Tony Vitello with another impactful bat since being called up, slashing .308 with four home runs, six RBI, and five runs scored through 19 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Trevor McDonald cruises through six in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Trevor McDonald allowed one hit while striking out five over six scoreless innings in Wednesday's win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: McDonald has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander remains another inconsistent option in the Giants rotation for manager Tony Vitello to this point, posting a 4.42 ERA and 1.23 WHIP to go with a 3-6 record and 7.9 K/9 ratio across 11 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Caleb Kilian shuts door for save in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Caleb Kilian struck out two over a scoreless inning to record the save in Wednesday's 6-4 win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: Kilian continues a strong stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in 10 of his last 12 contests. The right-hander looks to be locked in as the preferred closing option for manager Tony Vitello currently, posting a 4.00 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with a 2-4 record to go with a 10.8 K/9 ratio, three holds, and seven saves across 35 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Shea Langeliers goes deep in win over Dodgers
desc: Shea Langeliers went 2-for-5 in Wednesday's 7-1 win over the Dodgers with a solo home run.
impact: Langeliers has heated up again at the plate, picking up hits in six of his last seven contests. The catcher offers manager Mark Kotsay one of the more explosive bats in the Athletics lineup, carrying an .827 OPS with 20 home runs, 44 RBI, 51 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 79 games
